description: This file implements back-end APIs for the COSA Data Model related to routing, including functions for creating, initializing, retrieving info, adding, and deleting routing configurations. It handles static routes, routers, IPv4/IPv6 forwarding entries, and RIP interface settings, and interacts with the TR-181 data model via IRep folders. The code also manages persistent configurations via external files.

classes.name: COSA_DATAMODEL_ROUTING
classes.description: Data model class representing routing configuration, including lists of routers, static routes, RIP interfaces, and related parameters.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CosaRoutingCreate(VOID)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new routing data model object, returning its handle.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaRoutingInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes routing configuration by loading static routes, setting up registry folders, and populating router and interface lists.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaRoutingRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and removes routing configuration objects and related resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaRoutingRegGetInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves current router, IPv4, IPv6, and RIP interface configurations from persistent storage into the in-memory data structures.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaRoutingRegAddInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pNextInsNumName,ULONG ulNextInsNum,char * pPreffix,ULONG ulUpperInsNum,char * pAlias,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Adds a new routing configuration entry into the persistent storage under specific folders and updates associated in-memory structures.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaRoutingRegDelInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Deletes a routing configuration entry from persistent storage.

methods.name: char * CosaTimeGetRipdConfStaticPart(ANSC_HANDLE hContext)
methods.description: Generates a static string representation of current static routes for use in RIP configuration.

ctags.name: CosaRoutingRegAddInfo
ctags.signature: (ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pNextInsNumName,ULONG ulNextInsNum,char * pPreffix,ULONG ulUpperInsNum,char * pAlias,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
